recentItems.title: Autumn harvest draws visitors to Guizhou's scenic terraces
recentItems.description: Picturesque rice terraces cascade down the mountainsides in southwest China's Guizhou Province, as some 26,100 mu (1,740 hectares) of rice fields enter the harvest season. Set against traditional villages, the spectacular autumn scenery is also drawing visitors eager to take in the views and experience rural life.

recentItems.title: How a mountain school teacher brings his choir to the outside world
recentItems.description: It started with one music teacher, four children and a guitar in the mountains of Liangshan in southwest China. Today, the Niu Niu Choir has 398 young singers, taking their voices from rural classrooms to some of China's biggest stages.

recentItems.title: Global South needs stronger voice amid challenges: Egyptian expert
recentItems.description:
Diaa Helmy, secretary-general of the Egyptian-Chinese Chamber of Commerce, called for greater voice for the #GlobalSouth amid unprecedented challenges, and praised #China's efforts toward peaceful coexistence, shared benefits and a shared future.
"The only way out of the global crisis is more cooperation," he added.

recentItems.title: German business leader calls for cooperation, warns of decoupling risks
recentItems.description: Cooperation with China is the way forward, and decoupling is "complete nonsense" for German and European companies to stay competitive and innovative, said Academy of German Hidden Champions (ADWM) chairman Walter Doring at the 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade (CIFIT) in east China's Xiamen. #GLOBALink

recentItems.title: Australia-China PV collaboration powers world: Australian solar pioneer
recentItems.description: Martin Green, a pioneer in modern photovoltaics, says Australia-China PV collaboration has helped drive the widespread adoption of solar power. Today, Green is working with Chinese manufacturers on new cell technologies. #GLOBALink
